description: This skill manages autonomous navigation from a target location. It monitors path execution, obstacle avoidance, and progress towards the goal. The skill successfully terminates when the robot is sufficiently close to the target.

atomic_propositions.target_received: True when nav_status == 'accepted'. The navigation goal has been accepted by the planner.
atomic_propositions.path_planning_active: True when nav_status in ['accepted', 'executing']. The robot is actively engaged in navigation.
atomic_propositions.moving_towards_target: True when linear_vel > 0.05. The robot is currently moving forward.
atomic_propositions.obstacle_detected: True when min_range < 0.25. A close obstacle is detected within the safety threshold.
atomic_propositions.close_to_target: True when distance_to_target < 0.5. The robot is within the final stopping distance of the target.

named_failure_modes.name: collision_risk
named_failure_modes.description: The robot must never enter a state where a close obstacle is detected.

named_failure_modes.name: navigation_stuck
named_failure_modes.description: If navigation is active, the robot must eventually start moving towards the target.

execution_phases.description: The robot receives the target and begins executing the collision-free path.

terminal_success.description: Success is achieved when the robot's distance to the target is less than 0.5 meters.

terminal_failure.description: Failure occurs if a close obstacle is detected at any point during navigation.
